t: The LAP Ubertas fixed LED downlights are a 10-pack of integrated LED lighting units, designed for reliable indoor illumination. These round downlights feature a polished chrome bezel and offer tunable colour temperature, allowing selection between 2700K warm white, 4000K cool white, and 6000K daylight to suit various environments. With an IP65 rating, they are ideal for kitchens and bathrooms, including Zone 2 installations. The units are dimmable, providing flexible light control, and offer a 30,000-hour lifespan. A high Colour Rendering Index of 90 ensures accurate colour representation, making them a practical choice for domestic projects.
b: Fixed Design Offers Secure & Stable Lighting
